Firefox/Mozilla user preferences configuration file containing browser preference declarations. This appears to be a partially malformed prefs file with one invalid `user_pref` call and one unrecognized `foobar` function call.

## Key Components

| Function | Status | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `user_pref(false)` | ❌ Invalid | Missing required key/value arguments |
| `user_pref("browser.contextual-services.contextId", "...")` | ✅ Valid | Sets a contextual services UUID |
| `foobar("app.normandy.user_id", "...")` | ❌ Invalid | Unrecognized function; should be `user_pref` |

## Usage Example

A well-formed Mozilla prefs file follows this pattern:

```javascript
// Valid user_pref syntax: user_pref("key", value);
user_pref("browser.contextual-services.contextId", "{97961fa4-2a6a-470f-a916-45a3f51fc393}");
user_pref("app.normandy.user_id", "2324e712-7c70-4d9c-8e78-2a6eb9b2d967");
user_pref("browser.startup.homepage", "https://flamingo.run");
user_pref("app.normandy.enabled", false);
```

## Issues Found

- **Line 13** — `user_pref(false)`: Malformed call; `user_pref` requires two arguments: a string key and a value.
- **Line 15** — `foobar(...)`: Unknown function. Likely intended to be `user_pref`. As written, this preference will **not** be applied.

## Notes

- This file is **auto-managed** by Firefox and should not be edited manually while the browser is running.
- To safely override preferences, use a [`user.js`](https://kb.mozillazine.org/User.js_file) file in your Firefox profile directory.
- Preference GUIDs (e.g., contextId, normandy user_id) are generated per-profile and used for telemetry and A/B testing (Normandy experiments).

**Source:** [`prefs3.js`](https://github.com/flamingo-stack/fleetmdm/blob/main/prefs3.js)
